tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite source for educational YouTube videos. Create a strict3 by3 row-major grid of NINE full-body poses, every cell equal size. Highest native resolution available, transparent RGBA background. Input image1 is the EXACT adopted identity/style reference, not a pixel-edit target. Redraw fresh. The exact adopted Harvest Mouse shown in image1; identity features: 淡い黄褐色・小さい丸耳・一本の細い尾. Preserve the reference’s large head, exact torso LENGTH and WIDTH, short upright two-legged body and two arm-like forepaws. Never shorten/slim the torso or enlarge the head relative to it. Keep exactly the existing2 arms,2 legs and existing tail/horns/ears; do not create a tail on a tailless reference. Preserve its exact eye format when open (white surrounds only if the reference has them, same pupil and no added highlights), facial markings, palette, warm brown contours and subtle paper/watercolor texture. No realistic animal proportions or heavy outline change. All poses keep SAME anatomical head/body scale and proportions as the adopted reference, including every resting/blink/crouch state. Lots of true transparent padding around each complete subject and between cells; no cropped horns/gills/bill/tail/feet. No text, labels, grid lines, backgrounds, ground/shadow, props, sparkles, extra animals or duplicate/disconnected limbs. Required reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom: 1 BLINK: Same exact upright/resting body position, head size, torso length/width, limbs, supports and facing as image1, ONLY the eye(s) gently fully closed as a simple brown lid curve; mouth/expression otherwise unchanged. Do not crouch, nod, shrink or move the body during blink. 2 GREET: Friendly one-forepaw gentle raised greeting, feet planted and head/body scale unchanged. 3 PRESENT_LEFT: Connected forepaw/arm indicates VIEWER LEFT and gaze follows, feet remain planted. 4 PRESENT_RIGHT: Connected forepaw/arm indicates VIEWER RIGHT and gaze follows, feet remain planted. Generate a fresh matching opposite gesture, not a flip-copy. 5 THINK: One existing forepaw gently touches chin, curious head tilt, torso stable. 6 AHA: Small pleased discovery reaction: head perks and one forepaw slightly lifts, friendly eyes; no lightbulb/effect. 7 CHEER: Gentle pleased grounded celebration, two connected forepaws comfortably lifted, smiling closed eyes allowed; no jump or new props. 8 SPECIES_A: A tiny attentive head tilt with the existing ears angling slightly outward; torso, forepaws and planted feet remain stable. 9 SPECIES_B: Head begins to return and the existing ears settle slightly forward, without changing their reference length or shape. Species constraint: ウサギの長い耳と小型ネズミ類の丸い耳を混同しない。小さい耳を長耳へ変えず、尾の有無と長さも維持する。 Clean bounded color areas and connected silhouettes; no pigment spills, background haze or extra marks. Do not insert an additional neutral; it is reused from image1.
